rationale: The cluster [validate_failed::rule-cheat-sheet] (task t05-collection) indicates that validation passed but the harness expected a failure; the note points to rule coverage or cheat-sheet clarity. Collection libraries often miss asset listings (E11) or have ambiguous relation scopes (E12). By clarifying these rules in the cheat sheet—specifically that asset paths must be listed and scopes disambiguated—we improve the agent's awareness so it produces a pack that the validator would flag if incomplete, or the agent itself catches the issue pre‑validation. This directly addresses the unclear rule coverage.
expected_effect: Agents reading the cheat sheet will now understand that collection pages require exhaustive asset listings and proper scope disambiguation. In t05-collection, the agent will ensure these rules are satisfied, and if the validator previously passed despite missing assets or ambiguous scopes, the clarified expectation will lead to a corrected pack (or the agent will self‑check). The validation failure flag (missing rule enforcement) will be resolved because the pack will now contain the necessary data.
regression_risk: Low. The table structure and rule identifiers remain the same; only descriptions are extended with collection‑specific guidance. Passed tasks (t01, t03, t04) did not involve collection‑specific pitfalls and are unaffected. The addition of the note reinforces existing behavior, not introduces new requirements.
